svg.title: The six selected sensor pairs and common four-time schedules all use exactly eight readings.
svg.desc: Six zero-delay layouts share two fixed labeled sensors and four common times, totaling eight readings. Local-D, local-E, discrete extended-E and maximin are selected from the same 1,925 candidates using only frozen design information; equal spacing and center-plus-off-center are pre-fixed engineering controls. Repeated layouts are retained rather than treated as independent evidence. Each site in the upper panel receives every time shown for its method below.
